decisions.question: Pitfall 2 — How should `reviewer_code` learn the diff size to gate subagent fan-out (~10 files / ~500 LOC threshold)?

options.label: Option 2A: Orchestrator-side numstat plumbing — run `git diff --numstat` at prompt-build time and thread (files_changed, loc) into the scope preamble; orchestrator decides, reviewer obeys.
Option 2B: Reviewer self-gates — put the threshold rule in the prompt text and have the reviewer run `git diff --numstat` itself, choosing fan-out vs solo review based on what it sees.
Other (explain in reply)

decisions.question: Pitfall 3 — How should `reviewer_code` see the implement-phase task list for partition strategy?

options.label: Option 3A: Orchestrator-side contract loader — add a contract parameter (or pipeline_id load) to `_build_review_prompt()`, extract `phases.implement.tasks[]`, and embed the partition list in the prompt; fallback skips fan-out when tasks are empty.
Option 3B: Reviewer self-fetches — instruct the reviewer to call `mcp__sdlc__show_contract` and self-extract `phases.implement.tasks[]`; fallback skips fan-out when the list is empty.
Other (explain in reply)

decisions.question: How should the fan-out threshold "~10 changed files / ~500 LOC" be composed?

options.label: OR: trigger fan-out when EITHER files > 10 OR LOC > 500.
AND: trigger fan-out only when BOTH files > 10 AND LOC > 500.
Other (explain in reply)

decisions.question: When `reviewer_code` fans out into N subagents, how does each subagent see its slice of the diff?

options.label: Subagent re-runs `git diff` itself and filters by path glob to its assigned partition (parent passes only the partition spec).
Parent reviewer pre-slices the diff and passes the relevant patch fragment to each subagent in its prompt (parent does the partitioning work).
Other (explain in reply)

decisions.question: Should `security-review-criteria.md` and `concurrency-review-criteria.md` be standalone or inherit from `code-review-criteria.md`?

options.label: Inherit: each new file opens with an explicit 'Inherits from `code-review-criteria.md`; only lens-specific rules below override or extend it' header.
Standalone: each new file is fully self-contained with no cross-link, treating each lens as an independent criteria surface.
Other (explain in reply)

decisions.question: Where should the per-pipeline subagent-parallelism knob live (default parallel, override per pipeline)?

options.label: Environment variable read by the orchestrator at prompt-build time (e.g., `EGG_REVIEWER_SUBAGENT_PARALLEL=true|false`).
`phase_configs.implement.reviewer_code.parallel` field on the contract.
Top-level setting in `settings.json` / orchestrator config.
CLI flag on `egg-orch pipeline create` plumbed through to the contract.
Other (explain in reply)

decisions.question: How should the PR #1964 regression-replay test execute in CI?

options.label: Both modes: CI-unconditional prompt-text asserts (verifies prompt builder includes the subagent block above threshold and skips it below) PLUS opt-in live-LLM replay gated by `RUN_REVIEWER_REPLAY=1`.
Prompt-asserts only: deterministic, fast, no LLM cost; ship the live-LLM mode later if needed.
Live-LLM only: gated by `RUN_REVIEWER_REPLAY=1`; tests the actual reviewer behavior end-to-end but skipped in normal CI.
Other (explain in reply)
